Local painters who know the coast

Reliable painters across the Northern Beaches

The Northern Beaches is a beautiful place to own a home, and a tough one on paint. Salt air, sea spray and strong coastal sun break down exterior finishes far quicker than they do inland, so surfaces need proper preparation and quality coatings built to last near the water.

Mi Painting & Maintenance has spent more than four decades painting Sydney homes and businesses, from heritage cottages in Manly and Fairlight to weatherboard beach houses along the peninsula and modern rendered builds in Frenchs Forest and Belrose. We prepare thoroughly, use premium products, and leave your place clean and tidy.

  • Experienced with weatherboard, fibro, rendered and heritage homes
  • Weather-resistant systems suited to salt-air and coastal exposure
  • Colour consultation to match the coastal look you want

Good to know

Northern Beaches painting questions

Do you cover my part of the Northern Beaches?
Yes. We paint homes and businesses right across the region, from Manly, Fairlight and Balgowlah through Dee Why, Collaroy and Narrabeen, up to Mona Vale, Avalon and Palm Beach, and across the forest suburbs like Frenchs Forest and Belrose. If you are not sure, give us a call and we will confirm straight away.
How does coastal salt air affect exterior paint, and how do you handle it?
Salt, sea spray and strong sun wear down exterior finishes faster near the coast. We manage this with careful surface preparation, appropriate priming, and premium weather-resistant coatings suited to beachside conditions. Good prep is the difference between a coat that lasts and one that fails early.
Are you licensed and insured?
Yes. Mi Painting & Maintenance holds NSW Licence No. 495198C and is fully insured. We are also Dulux Accredited, so your project is handled by qualified professionals to a recognised standard.
How much does painting cost on the Northern Beaches?
Every job is different, so the price depends on the size of the area, the surfaces, the condition of the existing paint, and the finish you choose. We provide a free on-site quote with clear, itemised pricing and no hidden costs, so you can decide with confidence.
Do you paint apartment blocks and strata properties?
Yes. We work with strata committees, building managers and businesses across the Northern Beaches, and can schedule after-hours or weekend work to keep disruption to residents and trading to a minimum.
How soon can you start?
We are open 7 days including late evenings, and we aim to arrange your free quote quickly. Start dates depend on the current schedule and the scope of your project, and we will give you a realistic timeframe at the time of quoting.
